request: Rebuild Settings to match System Settings on this Mac

implementation.search: Every preference title, description, category and keywords; results retain query and reveal matching native row
implementation.window: Single retained native window; close/reopen keeps navigation; autosaved frame; tabs disallowed

verification.focusedTests: 5 passed: search, history, persisted switches, cold native window minimum and display bounds
liveObserved: Measured sidebar width matches System Settings
Search navigates to and reveals disabled inline-math row at bottom of long Markdown pane
Grouped rows, descriptions, switches and native back/forward toolbar
All five categories inspected in the final presentation
Search labels wrap to multiple lines
Native no-results state and cancel affordance
Settings close/reopen retains the selected row and scroll position
Real Settings switch changes the preview without modifying source
verification.finalLiveChecks: passed after unlock; every pane inspected; native popup opened/cancelled; keyboard back/forward; zoom/restore; close/reopen; multiline search results; no-results state; actual fence preview off/on with original enabled state and exact source restored; corrected sizing build also relaunched and observed
verification.hostedPackageAndCommonMark: passed: 199 package tests / 41 suites / eight arm64 executables; all 652 published CommonMark examples

windowRegression.symptom: First Settings window partially offscreen on a 1024-point display; right-side switches were unreachable
windowRegression.diagnosis: Before first layout, automatic hosting sizing reduced the native frame to 1×84 points after initial sizing. Centering that frame let later content grow beyond the screen.
windowRegression.fix: Shared form minimum; disable hosting automatic window sizing; explicitly set native content size before centering; constrain restored frames to the current visible display.
tests: A cold Settings host has its full minimum width before it is shown
Offscreen and disconnected-display positions fit the current display

limitations: Native framework appearance follows the installed OS rather than copying private System Settings implementation
Increase Contrast and VoiceOver end-to-end acceptance remain part of the broader modernization audit
